remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "O'Keeffe thinks this was painted about 1921. Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature" [note of inscriptions 1, 4]. Abiquiú Notebooks notes inscription 3. Backing inscription 4 dates 1920. Backing inscription 5 dates 1920 and indicates no. 40 in 1923 New York (Anderson). Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. Titled *Apple Family #1* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph, reproduced and titled *Still Life* in *Vanity Fair* (July 1922). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
